start.content: Jesus sent us ahead. He told us exactly where to find the colt and what to say if anyone questioned us. We weren't stealing anything! The Lord had authorised this.

choices.text: What about the rope at the post?

cloaks.content: Those are mine and John's cloaks. We used them as a saddle for the colt because it had never been ridden — we didn't want it to bolt on the road.

rope.content: John untied the rope — he didn't cut it. I don't know how it ended up cut. We were in a hurry to get back to the main crowd.

closing.content: The King is coming, and He's coming in peace. That's all you need to know.
